description: It runs the full readiness check of one webinar and answers point by point what is ready and what would break in front of the participants: pages, dates (including a thank you page that shows a different date), emails and their timing, the video source, the offer in the room, tracking and the form. The same check also reads the mail side: whether the site's mail cron runs, the spam score of the sending address, the send rate and what the server can carry, so a reminder does not fail silently. Take it when a host asks whether everything is ready. "Can I start tomorrow?" It is the webinar part of the setup checklist in the dashboard: the checklist collects every step for the webinar, this check is its readiness part, and the score lands in that panel. The result and its history are stored on the site. Nothing else on the webinar changes. Side effect: it stores the result and its history on the site, which is what the dashboard shows. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: readiness check, before launch, preflight, mail cron, spam score, what breaks

force.description: true runs the check even when a recent result exists.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.

name: wi_run_webinar_preflight
title: Run the readiness check before a webinar starts
